utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much are the membership dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it's twenty dollars this month.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. I'll bring twenty dollars then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with that, Noah. Just tell me what the dues are and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the dues. I think it’s around twenty bucks, but I should double-check the exact amount.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it, just let me know once you have the exact amount and I’ll take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, the dues are due this week, and I heard the amount stayed the same. I can check the notice board for the exact deadline if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks. I just want to make sure I pay on time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll go check the notice board and let you know the exact deadline.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can cover my share when the dues are due, and if you need help keeping track, I’m glad to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam. I’ll keep track of the dues and let you know when they’re due.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds good, Opal. Just let me know when the dues are due, and I’ll make sure my share is ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course, I can ask around and get more folks signed up if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help. Thank you, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll start asking around today and see who can chip in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I can help with that—just let me know if you need a little extra time to cover the dues.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. I may need a little extra time, but I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Leo. Just keep me posted, and we’ll work it out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I have this right before we go ahead. How much are the dues, and when are they due?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think it’s $20 a month, and they’re due at the start of each month.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so that means $20 each month, due at the start of the month?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check with the school calendar and get back to you about the dues.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye. Just let me know what you find out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the school calendar and follow up with the dues details as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the dues changed again, but I’m not sure what the new amount is. Did Jules say when they’re due?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think the dues are due at the start of the month, and I heard the new amount is $20.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, so it’s $20 and due at the start of the month, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll sort the dues out with you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean you’ll handle my dues directly?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, I mean I’ll handle your dues directly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can pay my share, but I’d like to know the amount first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I just need to check the amount with the treasurer and I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I’ll wait for the amount before I pay.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can remind her about the dues and make sure we settle it soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep track of it on my end too so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep an eye on it and remind her too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I paid mine last week, but I think the club still needs a few people to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can catch up on mine this week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that should help keep things moving. I’ll remind the others too so we can get the dues settled.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the dues. I think I owe mine too, unless I already handed it over and forgot again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I think I still owe mine too. Let’s check with the treasurer and settle it up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, let’s do that. I don’t want to accidentally pay twice.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the dues. I think I missed what changed, but I can check what I owe.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries, just check the posted amount and bring it by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll check the posted amount and bring the dues by soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can cover the dues if needed. How much is it this month?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s twenty dollars this month. I’ll bring my share by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That works for me. Thanks, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can cover my share of the dues this week, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, that takes care of it. I’ll let the others know so we can keep the club moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate you handling that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help sort that out. What amount did you have in mind for the dues?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: How about $20 a month for the dues?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds reasonable to me. We can start with $20 a month and see how it works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I can help with the dues. Let me know if you need the amount or the payment timing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa. I just need the amount and when it’s due.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The dues are $20, and they’re due by the end of the month.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the dues are going up again, but I haven't seen the details myself. Do you know what's actually due?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven’t seen the exact breakdown either. Let’s ask for the notice so we know what’s actually due.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, asking for the notice is the right move. I’d rather see the exact amount than go on rumors.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll pay my dues soon — just skimmed the notice and need the amount again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s $25, due by Friday if you can manage it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, I’ll bring $25 by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. How much are the dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the dues for this month, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right — I mean the dues for this month.
